Typically "end of" a month refers to roughly the last 7-10 days, so I'll interpret this as January 25th through January 31st (the actual end of the month).

The phrase "beginning of February" refers to the early part of February. Since the current date is January 15, 2026, we're looking at February 2026. "Beginning" typically means the first several days or first week of the month. I'll interpret this as the first 7-10 days of February.
